title: Playback-safe skip-ad improvements
message: Version 3.9.0 improves detection of explicit Skip Ad controls, throttles repeat clicks, and keeps ad cleanup away from video playback and DRM.
features: More reliable detection of explicit Skip Ad controls on supported sites
Clicks only visible, enabled controls clearly labelled for skipping or closing ads
Does not click Skip Intro, Skip Recap, or Next Episode controls
Restores page elements when protection is disabled or the site is allowlisted
Fail-open behavior: never manipulates video playback, media URLs, or DRM
